name: app-dark-smart-home-screens-collage-with-lit-hero-phone
title: Dark Smart-Home Screens with a Lit Hero
whatItIs: A black field filled with dim phone screens of many app states (climate, lock, schedule, main light, rooms) with one bright cream phone at the centre showing a climate control with an orange segmented gauge.
whatItMeans: Dimming the rest lets the hero screen glow, while the ghosted screens prove the depth of the app.
techniques: Many screens dimmed to near black as texture
One fully lit hero phone in the centre
Orange segmented arc as the signature graphic

vocabulary.definition: Secondary content faded to let a hero stand out.
An arc made of radial dashes.
The one screen shown in full brightness.
